vectors.name: formats-toml/nonfinite/nan-is-a-number
vectors.comment: C-19: TOML spells it `nan`. E-33 encodes the non-finite number as the string `NaN`. Verified live 2026-10-18 at the ports default-branch tips: passes on Python, TypeScript, Go, Java; fails on Rust (DIV-47, expected until adopted).
